fr_html:
Le PRESIDENT rouvre la discussion sur les articles 25 et 26 du projet Root—Phillimore. Il appelle l'attention du Comité sur l'amendement déposé par Lord Phillimore en vue de se rapprocher du point de vue du Président, et comme suite à sa déclaration de la veille.

Cet amendement est ainsi conçu :
en_html: The PRESIDENT re-opened the discussion on Articles 25 and 26 of the Root—Phillimore plan, and drew the Committee's attention to the amendment presented by Lord Phillimore, in accordance with his statement on the previous day, with a view to reconciling the President's point of view and his own. This amendment was worded as follows :
